review_focus: Every loop has entry, exit, budget, backoff, progress signal, and failure policy
Consequential effects are guarded by idempotency and deduplication
Hot spins, infinite retries, and hidden recurrence are prevented

stage_result.summary: Defined bounded Phase4 loops for compact load, lazy model fetch, local fuzzy filtering, chip expansion, and verification.

checks.name: Loop schema
checks.evidence: loop_spec.json includes loop IDs, entry/exit conditions, guardrails, budgets, convergence, tests, and traceability

decisions.decision: Do not add background retry or polling for model catalog loading.
decisions.reason: A bounded one-shot fetch plus manual entry avoids hidden loops and stalled UX.
